title.narrative: Humanitäre Hilfe in den Bereichen Ernährung, WASH sowie Unterkunft für Binnenvertriebene im Nordshan und Kachin

description.narrative: 100% of the target groups are conflict affected individuals and/or families. The project will benefit 25,104 IDPs (12,138 M, 12966 F) from 5,021 households currently living in 39 camps in Kachin and Northern Shan states. The selection of the IDP camps benefiting of the intervention is the result of a process of discussions and consultations between Metta and other JST members and other local actors. Metta will take responsibility for the 39 camps / relocation sites in Kachin and Northern Shan states. The project will give preferential treatment in the selection process to female-headed households, women and widows, unaccompanied children (girls in particular), the elderly and people with disabilities, pregnant women and lactating mothers.

Impact: The basic needs regarding food, WASH and shelter are fulfilled and protection risks reduced for conflict affected IDPs and most vulnerable groups in Kachin State and Sagaing Region.Outcome: Immediate needs of IDPs and host communities with regards to food, WASH and shelter in 37 IDP camps and 10 host communities in in the target area are met.

The project is the continuation of an ongoing engagement of Metta with AA support in a lasting complex emergency in Myanmar's Kachin and Northern Shan State. The intervention shall maintain current IDP camp support by covering basic needs and provide essential food assistance/cash provision to purchase food items for IDPs that otherwise would face severe food shortage. Critical WASH and shelter gaps area also addressed (latrine construction, bathing space for women and girls, hygiene promotion).
